# Anatomical source for the knight rebuild

`Blender_CC0_Male_Anatomy.blend` contains only the realistic male body and its two fitted eye meshes from **Blender Human Base Meshes v1.4.1**, provided by the Blender community and Blender Studio.

Official source: https://download.blender.org/demo/asset-bundles/human-base-meshes/human-base-meshes-bundle-v1.4.1.zip

The bundle's embedded README states that all provided assets are public domain under **CC0**. It supplies anatomical quad topology, UVs, and sculpted multiresolution detail. The unrelated Rain rig is not used or included in the extracted anatomy file.

Hydro Drift's armor, helmet, apparel, materials, character adjustments, body skeleton, static-finger weights, and game preparation are authored in this repository. The anatomical base is third-party work; it is not claimed as original Hydro Drift modeling.

The full downloaded bundle and the unused MakeHuman candidate are local reference downloads and are excluded from version control. Only the selected anatomical source above is needed to rebuild the knights.
